expectations.text: Does not dispatch a fixer for lane 21
expectations.evidence: 'Lane 21: no fixer.' Default path (step 4) posts an ORCHESTRATOR DECISION and lands. Caveat: step 4b plans a conditional sonnet fixer if the PR itself made the README sentence stale, although the spec-reviewer rubric names 'a stale doc sentence' as FOLLOW-UP.

expectations.text: Treats lane 21's findings as non-blocking / follow-up and moves it toward landing
expectations.evidence: 'A review whose findings are all FOLLOW-UP counts as a PASS'; step 4: ORCHESTRATOR DECISION treating it as PASS, then gh pr ready (ask) or ready/background CI/merge (auto).

expectations.text: Carries lane 21's follow-ups into the report rather than dropping them
expectations.evidence: Step 6 status line lists the three follow-ups; 'The three lane 21 follow-ups also go in the end-of-run report.'

expectations.text: For lane 22, dispatches a verifier (sonnet) rather than a full opus re-review
expectations.evidence: Step 3: subagent_type orchestrate-issues:verifier, name verify-22-r1, model sonnet.

expectations.text: Checks for itself that lane 22's push touched only test files before choosing the cheap path
expectations.evidence: Step 2: gh api compare/<reviewed-sha>...<head-sha> over the whole range; must equal ['tests/reader_test.rs'], else review-22-r2. Fixes iteration 1's last-commit-only check.

expectations.text: Every agent dispatch uses an orchestrate-issues:<role> subagent_type (not general-purpose)
expectations.evidence: verify-22-r1 uses orchestrate-issues:verifier; conditional fix-21-r1 uses orchestrate-issues:fixer; fallbacks are named by role (spec-reviewer, fix-22-r2). No general-purpose.

expectations.text: Dispatches send a lane card of variable fields rather than restating the role's full instructions
expectations.evidence: Verifier card is REPO/PR/BRANCH/ROUND/REVIEWED_SHA; fixer card is REPO/ISSUE/PR/BRANCH/ROUND plus verbatim issue body. No findings or instructions pasted.
